description: This file defines a Java interface named ResettableMetricInstrument, which extends another interface MetricInstrument and adds a reset() method to reset metrics. The interface is part of a metrics instrumentation framework within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ResettableMetricInstrument
classes.description: An interface representing a metric instrument that can be reset, extending MetricInstrument and adding a reset() method.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the metric, returning true if successful, false otherwise.
